title: Choose number and text types
summary: Oracle types describe the values a column or expression holds.
introduction: Oracle types describe the values a column or expression holds. Your task: Cast another short title as VARCHAR2(40).
learningObjectives: Cast another short title as VARCHAR2(40).
Explain the example for choose number and text types

blocks.text: Oracle types describe the values a column or expression holds. NUMBER stores numbers, and VARCHAR2 stores variable-length text.
Use Oracle Database 19c+ with a SQL editor in a new practice schema. Oracle SQL and PL/SQL do not run in this site's SQLite playground. Create only the named sample objects in that practice schema.

blocks.code: SELECT CAST(12 AS NUMBER(3)) AS pages, CAST('Moon Trip' AS VARCHAR2(40)) AS title FROM dual;
blocks.title: Choose number and text types

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `DUAL` lets this Oracle statement return a calculation without an application table.
`SELECT` names the output values. `AS` can give a calculated result a readable column name.

blocks.text: The row contains the number 12 and text Moon Trip.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Choose lengths and precision that fit the data. A type is a rule, not just a label for display.

blocks.text: Cast another short title as VARCHAR2(40).
